summary: Interacting with certain villagers with the villager trade rebalance enabled causes client crash
description: When interacting with a villager with the villager trade rebalance enabled, if that villager s career and level could generate ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type trades that sell enchanted items (e.g. plains armorer), then the game will crash. To reproduce: - Create a new world. Make sure the villager trade rebalance is enabled. - Level an armorer up to either expert (does not apply to expert level taiga villagers) or master level. - Save and quit the world. - Reopen the world. - Interact with the armorer. - The game will crash. I ve also attached both a crash report from a vanilla client and one that is deobfuscated with the official mappings.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new world.
2. Ensure the villager trade rebalance feature is enabled.
3. Level an armorer villager to either expert or master level.
4. Save and quit the world.
5. Reopen the world.
6. Interact with the leveled-up armorer villager.
7. Observe that the game crashes upon interaction.
Observed Behavior: When interacting with certain villagers, specifically those with the villager trade rebalance enabled, the game crashes if the villager's career and level can generate ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type trades that sell enchanted items, such as an expert or master-level plains armorer. To reproduce this issue, create a new world with the villager trade rebalance feature enabled, then level up an armorer to either expert (excluding expert-level taiga villagers) or master level. Save and quit the world, then reopen it and interact with the armorer; this will cause the game to crash. Both vanilla client crash reports and deobfuscated crash reports using official mappings have been attached for further analysis.
Expected Behavior: When interacting with an armorer villager at expert or master level, with the villager trade rebalance enabled, the game should display the available trades without crashing. The player should be able to see and complete trades for enchanted items like diamond armor pieces, and the game should remain stable throughout these interactions.
